Cannot directly read R2 workspace from sparse worktree; workspace_object_sha256 = dbd50e5c30e8a031f844e02362ffd53b25e3230e75eeef19bf3825543cb81197 as pre-stated in E3-A handoff.

taxonomy.drop_rationale: geography not needed: EU/China story covered by regulation; capital_structure superseded by capital_allocation for this exchange set.

scoring_method.exchange_boundary_quality: Exact ordinal match on 7 operator-delimited boundaries (ordinal 0-6). Gold uses Operator-intro segment method (segs 32,42,52,63,76,84,97). Precision = TP/(TP+FP), Recall = TP/(TP+FN) where TP = model boundary matches gold boundary (same operator-intro segment_index ±0). No partial credit.
scoring_method.source_span_replay_success: Percent of accepted model spans where segment_index, start_byte, end_byte locate a unique byte range in the transcript fixture. Computed by loading fixture, extracting segment[segment_index].text.encode()[start_byte:end_byte], and verifying non-empty and hash-matching.
scoring_method.unsupported_candidate_rate: Count of model candidates rejected because the proposed span text cannot be located at the stated locator in the source fixture. Rate = rejected_unsupported / total_candidates.
scoring_method.cross_event_contamination: Count of accepted model outputs referencing event_id or document_id not matching the AAPL FY2026 Q3 frozen source package.
scoring_method.topic_label_agreement: For each matched exchange: Jaccard similarity J = |gold_topics ∩ model_topics| / |gold_topics ∪ model_topics|. Mean J across matched exchanges. Requires exact enum membership per taxonomy_version.
scoring_method.identity_role_availability: For each exchange: (a) questioner name match (exact string after strip), (b) questioner affiliation match, (c) all gold respondent names present in model respondents (ordered check). Availability = matches / gold fields.
scoring_method.invalid_schema_rate: Count of accepted model outputs failing schema validation (missing required fields, unknown enum values, non-string types). Rate = invalid_accepted / total_accepted.
scoring_method.qwen_success_rate: Fraction of Qwen calls returning valid JSON candidate set (not degraded/timeout).
scoring_method.retry_fallback_rate: Fraction of model calls requiring retry or provider fallback. Each rung ledgered separately.
scoring_method.latency_ms: Wall-clock time from first model call to last response, in milliseconds.
scoring_method.model_cost_usd: Total cost in USD from lib.ai_costs ledger, lane=earnings_event_compiler.

usefulness_bar.written_refusal: N=7 is too small to support a statistically defensible numeric precision/recall or F1 threshold. A single boundary error changes recall by 14.3% (1/7). Any numeric bar (e.g. 0.90) would be theatrical — the confidence interval on a proportion with N=7 spans the majority of [0,1]. The evaluation instead measures all §10.2 metrics and reports against the already-frozen hard safety gates: accepted_unsupported=0, cross_event=0, span_replay=100%_of_accepted, invalid_schema=0_accepted. The decision on whether to grant E3-B production authority based on qualitative metrics and measured outputs is returned to Sol per freeze §10.1 step 8.

source_available_at.note: Transcript source_available_at is issuer/provider transcript publication availability, never conference/call time. Native availability timestamp for tx:AAPL/2026Q3 is not held in this evaluation. clock_state=unknown per freeze §3.
